cards.ex: She seems to derive great satisfaction from helping others.
cards.exUz: U boshqalarga yordam berishdan katta qoniqish hosil qiladiganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir mamnuniyat, rohat his qilish, undan bahramand bo'lish.

cards.ex: I get a real buzz from performing on stage.
cards.exUz: Men sahnada chiqish qilishdan haqiqiy hayajon olaman.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va yoqimli his-tuyg'ularni boshdan kechirish, hayajonlanish.

cards.ex: Ever since he met her, he's been in seventh heaven.
cards.exUz: U uni uchratganidan beri, u yetti osmonda.
cards.uzDef: O'zini juda xursand va baxtiyor his qilish, oliy darajada mamnun bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new job ticks all the boxes for me: good pay, flexible hours, and interesting work.
cards.exUz: Yangi ish men uchun hamma talablarga javob beradi: yaxshi maosh, moslashuvchan soatlar va qiziqarli ish.
cards.uzDef: Hamma kerakli talablarga javob beradigan, barcha jihatlari maqul bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He takes great delight in proving people wrong.
cards.exUz: U odamlarning xato ekanligini isbotlashdan katta rohat oladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir katta zavq va mamnuniyat olish, undan huzurlanish.

cards.ex: Volunteering gave her a real sense of fulfillment.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilik unga haqiqiy bajarilganlik hissini berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadiga erishganlik, hayotda muvaffaqiyatga erishganlik hissi.

cards.ex: Getting that project finished was a real weight off my shoulders.
cards.exUz: Bu loyihani tugatish mening yelkamdan katta yukni olib tashladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavotirli vaziyat tugaganidan keyin yengillik his qilish.

cards.ex: I get a buzz out of solving difficult puzzles.
cards.exUz: Men murakkab jumboqlarni yechishdan hayajonlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir kuchli hayajon va zavq olish.

cards.ex: The team basked in the glory of their championship win.
cards.exUz: Jamoa chempionlik g'alabasidan keyin shon-shuhratda cho'mildi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba yoki muvaffaqiyatdan keyin shon-shuhratdan bahramand bo'lish.

cards.ex: After landing that promotion, he's been riding high for weeks.
cards.exUz: U lavozimga ko'tarilgandan so'ng, u bir necha haftadan beri juda baxtiyor.
cards.uzDef: Juda muvaffaqiyatli va xursand bo'lish, yaxshi natijalarga erishish.

cards.ex: She gets a thrill out of extreme sports, like skydiving.
cards.exUz: U osmondan sakrash kabi ekstremal sportlardan hayajon oladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir kuchli, yoqimli hayajonni his qilish.

cards.ex: Ever since they got engaged, she's been walking on air.
cards.exUz: Ular unashtirilgandan beri, u osmonda uchayotgandek.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand bo'lish, o'zini baxtdan yengil his qilish.

cards.ex: They were on cloud nine after their baby was born.
cards.exUz: Farzandlari tug'ilgandan keyin ular yettinchi osmonda edilar.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand, baxtiyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Finishing the marathon gave her a great sense of accomplishment.
cards.exUz: Marafonni tugatish unga katta erishganlik hissini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani muvaffaqiyatli yakunlagandan so'ng paydo bo'ladigan qoniqish hissi.

cards.ex: Her family is her greatest source of happiness.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi uning eng katta baxt manbai.
cards.uzDef: Baxt va quvonch keltiradigan narsa yoki kimdir.

cards.ex: She decided to live life to the fullest after her recovery.
cards.exUz: U sog'ayib ketganidan keyin hayotni to'liq yashashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdan maksimal darajada zavqlanish, har bir imkoniyatdan foydalanish.

cards.ex: This massage is a real treat after a long week at work.
cards.exUz: Bu massaj ishdagi uzoq haftadan keyin haqiqiy rohat.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy zavq, qoniqish beradigan narsa yoki voqea.

cards.ex: He was as happy as Larry when he found out he'd won the competition.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada g'alaba qozonganini bilib, juda xursand edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand, baxtiyor holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: She'll be tickled pink when she gets that promotion.
cards.exUz: U lavozimga ko'tarilganida juda xursand bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir juda xursand bo'lish.

cards.ex: I get a kick out of watching old movies.
cards.exUz: Men eski filmlarni tomosha qilishdan zavqlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir zavq olmoq, qiziqish his qilmoq.

cards.ex: I try to count my blessings every day, even when things are tough.
cards.exUz: Men har kuni bor narsalarimga shukrona keltirishga harakat qilaman, hatto qiyin paytlarda ham.
cards.uzDef: Bor narsalariga minnatdor bo'lish, shukrona keltirish.

cards.ex: We might not have much time, so let's make the most of it.
cards.exUz: Bizda ko'p vaqt bo'lmasligi mumkin, shuning uchun undan eng yaxshisini olaylik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan maksimal foyda olmoq, eng yaxshi natijaga erishmoq.

cards.ex: She decided to quit her job and travel the world, determined to live life to the fullest.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shash va dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishga qaror qildi, hayotdan to'liq zavqlanishga intildi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdan to'liq zavq olib, har bir lahzani qadrlash.

cards.ex: He found fulfillment in helping others.
cards.exUz: U boshqalarga yordam berishda qoniqish topdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsada ma'no topib, qoniqish his qilish.

cards.ex: She's a happy camper now that she's finished her exams.
cards.exUz: U imtihonlarni tugatgandan so'ng, u mamnun odamga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Mamnun, xursand odam.

cards.ex: Even though it rained all day, we tried to look on the bright side.
cards.exUz: Kun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'gan bo'lsa ham, biz vaziyatga ijobiy qarashga harakat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning ijobiy tomonlarini ko'rish, optimistik bo'lish.

cards.ex: I felt like I was on top of the world when I got the job offer.
cards.exUz: Ish taklifini olganimda, o'zimni baxt cho'qqisida his qildim.
cards.uzDef: O'zini juda baxtli his qilish, eng yaxshi holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I take pleasure in reading a good book.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshi kitob o'qishdan zavq olaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir zavq his qilmoq, qoniqish topmoq.

cards.ex: Opening my own business was a dream come true.
cards.exUz: O'z biznesimni ochish orzuyim ushaldi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri orzu qilingan narsa amalga oshdi.

cards.ex: I'm in a good place right now; I'm happy and healthy.
cards.exUz: Men hozir yaxshi holatdaman; xursandman va sog'lomman.
cards.uzDef: Ruhoniy, hissiy tomondan yaxshi holatda bo'lish.
